limits: This accepts only the frozen source-base component tests and fixed cancellation controls; it does not validate a later current-main composition.
No dashboard asset build, native browser, live-cluster request, Pod installation/shipment/startup, runtime/catalog proof, mesh enrollment or connector activation is accepted.
